rows.freeTier: Community volunteer text inference, including anonymous access. Kudos determine queue priority and cannot be bought or sold. No cash billing or paid overage.
rows.note: Native asynchronous volunteer text inference with the declared Gemma 4 instruction template (https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/core/prompt-formatting-gemma4). Receiver tools use native literal tool request frames or the JSON assistant envelope; every request is admitted locally before any effect. No native structured-output enforcement is claimed. The selected model must match the resulting generation. Cancellation deletes only the job created by that invocation. Token usage remains unknown when the worker does not report it. Exact default model observed in the live text model catalogue on 2026-10-08.

routingPolicy.rule: Route ordinary (non-premium-review) inference demand free-first: try local Ollama, then the armed cloud free tiers in freeFirstOrder, in order. On a rate-limit or capacity refusal (HTTP 429, or a provider body naming a quota/rate-limit condition) from one entry, retry the next entry in freeFirstOrder. Never fall back past the end of freeFirstOrder to a paid or frontier provider without an explicit, separate customer decision outside this adapter -- this package exports no implicit paid fallback, and none should be added to it.
